packageRules.description: Automerge npm patch updates for stable packages
Automerge npm minor updates for stable packages

Automerge 0.x patch updates, devDependencies only. The two rules above require >= 1.0.0, which silently excluded every pre-1.0 package and left green PRs sitting open for weeks. Pre-1.0 patch bumps can still break, so runtime dependencies stay manual; dev tooling that breaks fails loudly in CI.
Actions releases wait three days, as npm does through security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm. Pins have no release date and are left out.

The image scanner in ci.yml is itself the supply-chain risk it guards against (estate ADR-008): never automerged, and a release waits a week, long enough for a compromised one to be pulled. After the automerge and three-day rules so it overrides both.
@khelias/ui is never automerged: each header release is reviewed and merged here, on this app's own schedule (estate ADR-014).
